subject: design/inherited-learning-repair
statement: Add `memory repair` as a Go orchestration verb. Accept one `--record Learning-<ULID>`, one `--report <JSON-file>` containing a unique matching Learning, or `--query <text>` containing one literal Learning identity. Reject conflicting operands, multiple identities and text with no usable identity. Do not infer an identity through an LLM, a summary hash or task-description similarity.
